answer: The signal multiplier is published, charged in ivory, and velvet lists each payment. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 13 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 3824 identities would post 2258 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
